mapper.select: SELECT id, source_topic AS sourceTopic, message_key AS messageKey, message_value AS messageValue, exception_class AS exceptionClass, exception_message AS exceptionMessage, retry_count AS retryCount, status, created_at AS createdAt, replay_attempt_token AS replayAttemptToken, replay_started_at AS replayStartedAt, replay_deadline_at AS replayDeadlineAt FROM dead_letter_messages WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE dead_letter_messages SET status = 'REPLAYING', replay_attempt_token = #{attemptToken}, replay_started_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), replay_deadline_at = TIMESTAMPADD( MICROSECOND, #{recoveryHorizonMillis} * 1000, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'DEAD'

UPDATE dead_letter_messages SET status = 'UNCERTAIN' WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'REPLAYING' AND replay_attempt_token IS NOT NULL AND replay_attempt_token = #{attemptToken} AND replay_deadline_at IS NOT NULL AND replay_deadline_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)
